description: Two-tone fifth-order intermodulation and IP5 (conventions: Two-tone intermodulation; ADR 0117).

cases.source: by hand: y = x + 0.01x^5 on cos + cos at 100 and 110 bins: products (5/8)(0.01) at 80 and 130; third-order products at 90 and 120, ten bins from every group
by hand: y = x - 0.02x^5 on cos + 0.5 cos at 400 and 470 bins: lower product 260, upper 610 folded to 414, coefficients (5/8)a5 A1^3 A2^2 and (5/8)a5 A1^2 A2^3
by hand: y = x; neither product has power, so ip5 is +inf
by hand: y = x + 0.2|x|^4 x on 0.5(e^{jw1 n} + e^{jw2 n}) at -40 and 60 bins: fifth-order lines a5 A^5 at -240 and 260, third-order 5 a5 A^5 at -140 and 160
f2 must be at most sample_rate/2
the f2 group has no power
